worldcombat.skill.fling.summary: Throw one real held item with its own effect. Allies can catch and eat Berries without hostile physical damage. An uneaten item is dropped or broken according to the setting.
worldcombat.skill.fling.use.1: Hand a Flame Orb or Poison Barb to the foe
worldcombat.skill.fling.use.2: Give a Berry back to the opponent
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.0: Hurls the held item at the target for %1$s Dark physical damage; the item's fling weight sets the power.
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.1: Reach is %1$s blocks with %2$s seconds of preparation. Berries apply their own healing, cure or stat effect. Offensive item effects still require a successful authorized enemy hit.
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.2: One item is atomically removed from the native stack at launch. An eaten Berry cannot also drop. Other items normally land with a %1$s-second pickup delay; disabling drops breaks them for x1.2 hostile power.
worldcombat.skill.fling.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.leave: On: the item drops where it lands and can be picked up or used later, at normal power; Off: it shatters on impact, leaves nothing, and hits at x1.2 power.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.ai.ma: Only throw within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.ai.le: When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to throw; when off it stays put.
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.proj: The item flies in an arc at %1$s blocks per tick with a %2$s-block hit radius, and knocks the target back %3$s blocks on a hit.
